options.name: add_keys_to_agent
options.description: Sets the C(AddKeysToAgent) option.

options.name: address_family
options.description: Sets the C(AddressFamily) option.

options.name: controlmaster
options.description: Sets the C(ControlMaster) option.

options.name: controlpath
options.description: Sets the C(ControlPath) option.

options.name: controlpersist
options.description: Sets the C(ControlPersist) option.

options.name: dynamicforward
options.description: Sets the C(DynamicForward) option.

options.name: forward_agent
options.description: Sets the C(ForwardAgent) option.

options.name: group
options.description: Which group this configuration file belongs to. If none given, O(user) is used.

options.name: host
options.description: The endpoint this configuration is valid for. It can be an actual address on the internet or an alias that connects to the value of O(hostname).

options.name: host_key_algorithms
options.description: Sets the C(HostKeyAlgorithms) option.

options.name: hostname
options.description: The actual host to connect to when connecting to the host defined.

options.name: identities_only
options.description: Specifies that SSH should only use the configured authentication identity and certificate files (either the default files, or those explicitly configured in the C(ssh_config) files or passed on the ssh command-line), even if C(ssh-agent) or a C(PKCS11Provider) or C(SecurityKeyProvider) offers more identities.

options.name: identity_file
options.description: The path to an identity file (SSH private key) that is used when connecting to this host. File need to exist and have mode V(0600) to be valid.

options.name: other_options
options.description: Allows specifying arbitrary SSH config entry options using a dictionary. The key names must be lower case. Keys with upper case values are rejected. The values must be strings. Other values are rejected.

options.name: port
options.description: The actual port to connect to when connecting to the host defined.

options.name: proxycommand
options.description: Sets the C(ProxyCommand) option. Mutually exclusive with O(proxyjump).

options.name: proxyjump
options.description: Sets the C(ProxyJump) option. Mutually exclusive with O(proxycommand).

options.name: remote_user
options.description: Specifies the user to log in as.

options.name: ssh_config_file
options.description: SSH config file. If O(user) and this option are not specified, C(/etc/ssh/ssh_config) is used. Mutually exclusive with O(user).

options.name: state
options.description: Whether a host entry should exist or not.

options.name: strict_host_key_checking
options.description: Whether to strictly check the host key when doing connections to the remote host. The value V(accept-new) is supported since community.general 8.6.0.

options.name: user
options.description: Which user account this configuration file belongs to. If none given and O(ssh_config_file) is not specified, C(/etc/ssh/ssh_config) is used. If a user is given, C(~/.ssh/config) is used. Mutually exclusive with O(ssh_config_file).

options.name: user_known_hosts_file
options.description: Sets the user known hosts file option.
